diagnostics.message: `weight` can't be derived field by field: it returns `f32`; a derived method returns `()`, `bool`, `Ordering`, `Self`, `Result<Self, E>` or `Result<(), E>`
notes: a `@fieldwise` trait's methods are derived for each type that declares it, unless they have a default (§3)
diagnostics.title: a `@fieldwise` trait method that can't be derived
